title: Episode 1
overview: Aoi Tokura is a new part-time employee at the Rainy Color café. He's also surrounded by a colorful cast of coworkers.

title: Episode 2
overview: The owner, Kouji, is always missing or goofing off. What exactly does he do all day ?

title: Episode 3
overview: The guys help open up shop while Keiichi finds himself distracted by a digital manga.

title: Episode 4
overview: Is there a secret to get on Keiichi's good side? Rain may have found the answer.

title: Episode 5
overview: Despite having completely different personalities, Ryouta has big plans for him and Keiichi.

title: Episode 6
overview: Aoi is used to being called a girl, but what do the others think about it?

title: Episode 7
overview: Ryouta steps in to try and settle Keiichi and Aoi's little misunderstanding.

title: Episode 8
overview: Ryouta tries to "sweet talk" Keiichi into forgiving Aoi.

title: Episode 9
overview: Keiichi and Aoi get some helpful advice about their conflict.

title: Episode 10
overview: During a slow day at the café, Shion and Aoi talk about relationships.

title: Episode 11
overview: Aoi and Keiichi want to talk but just can't seem to find each other.

title: Episode 12
overview: Everyone comes together and Aoi and Keiichi finally understand one another.
